description: Expected organic CTR by average position, used when ctr_benchmark is auto. Values are fractions (0.28 = 28%). Generic, rounded figures in line with published industry click-through studies for desktop and mobile web results combined; they are not specific to any site or market. Positions between anchors are linearly interpolated; positions past the last anchor use the last value. Replace with your own curve via ctr_benchmark custom if you have one.
